nodes.source_text: The NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE were obtained by immersing the TSC–NiFe LDHs in 1.0 M KOH for anion exchange.

A three-electrode setup was used to evaluate the OER performance in 1.0 M KOH... NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE possesses the highest OER performance with an overpotential of 233 mV at 50 mA cm⁻²... overpotential (204 mV) of the NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE at 10 mA cm⁻²... lowest Tafel slope of 22 mV dec⁻¹... NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE shows the smallest R_ct... largest double-layer capacitance (C_dl) of 5.99 mF cm⁻²... demonstrates good working stability at 100 mA cm⁻²... catalytic activity even increased after the long-term stability test
NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE (255 mV)... Tafel slope... NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE 32 mV dec⁻¹... NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE (2.36 mF cm⁻²)
NiFe LDHs (340 mV)... Tafel slope of 48 mV dec⁻¹... NiFe LDHs (2.33 mF cm⁻²)
The multistep chronopotentiometry curve of the NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE... from 20 to 140 mA cm⁻² without iR correction; shows good mass transport properties... and excellent electrical conductivity

nodes.description: Long-term stability test at 100 mA/cm² in 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: The i-t curve... shows that the NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE demonstrates good working stability at 100 mA cm⁻² without iR correction. The catalytic activity even increased after the long-term stability test

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDHs (003) d-spacing 7.5 Å; TSC–NiFe LDHs peaks negatively shifted relative to NiFe LDHs (PDF No. 49–0188), (003) d-spacing 12.6 Å; EDTA-NiFe LDHs matches EDTA-intercalated AlZn LDH pattern, (003) d-spacing 13.9 Å; NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE and NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE similar to control NiFe LDHs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XRD pattern (Fig. 2a) of the EDTA-NiFe LDHs matches well with that of the EDTA-intercalated AlZn LDH ... The diffraction peaks of the TSC–NiFe LDHs are negatively shifted relative to those of the control NiFe LDHs (PDF No. 49–0188), indicating the expansion of the interlayer spacing ... The spacing between the adjacent (003) crystal planes was calculated to be 7.5, 12.6, and 13.9 Å for the NiFe LDHs, TSC–NiFe LDHs, and EDTA-NiFe LDHs, respectively. The XRD patterns of the NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE and NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE are similar to that of the control NiFe LDHs (Fig. 2b).

nodes.characterization_summary: EDTA-NiFe LDHs shows COO- stretching at 1576 and 1386 cm⁻¹, C–N at 1107 cm⁻¹; TSC–NiFe LDHs shows COO- at 1553 and 1384 cm⁻¹, C–O at 1252 and 1069 cm⁻¹; NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE shows C–N at 1117 cm⁻¹ and CO₃²⁻ at 1354 cm⁻¹; NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE shows C–O at 1069 cm⁻¹ and CO₃²⁻ at 1354 cm⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The FTIR spectrum of the EDTA-NiFe LDHs exhibits the symmetric and asymmetric stretching vibrations of the COO- at 1576 and 1386 cm⁻¹, respectively, and the stretching vibration of the C–N at 1107 cm⁻¹ (Fig. S1a)... After anion exchange (Fig. 2c), the presence of EDTA on the NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE was confirmed by the C–N stretching vibration peak at 1117 cm⁻¹, while the presence of TSC on the NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE was verified by the C–O stretching vibration peak at 1069 cm⁻¹. The absorption band around 1354 cm⁻¹ in the FTIR spectra indicates the presence of CO₃²⁻.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE and NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE show two characteristic ν(Niᴵᴵ-O) vibrations; control NiFe LDHs shows β-FeOOH signals at 700-800 cm⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE and NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE show similar Raman spectra (Fig. 2d), both of which demonstrate two characteristic signals from the ν(Niᴵᴵ-O) vibrations... Note that the control NiFe LDHs show the characteristic Fe-O stretching vibration signals of β-FeOOH between 700-800 cm⁻¹.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDTA-NiFe LDHs shows sponge-like structure; NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE displays nanosheet morphology composed of nanoparticles; NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE and NiFe LDHs show nanosheet morphology.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The EDTA-NiFe LDHs show sponge-like structure (Fig. 3a), while the TSC–NiFe LDHs form layer-stacked structure (Fig. S2a). After the interlayer anions were replaced with the CO₃²⁻ anions, the NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE displays nanosheet morphology (Fig. 3b–d).

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDHs shows Ni 2p₃/₂ at 855.1 eV (Ni(III)), 856.5 eV (Ni(II)); NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE and NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE show positively shifted Ni(II) 2p₃/₂ peaks by 0.10 and 0.33 eV; Fe 2p peaks at 711.8 and 725.5 eV (Fe(III)), satellites at 716.1 and 728.9 eV (Fe(II)); NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE and NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE have more Ni(III) and Fe(II); O 1s peaks at 528.8 eV (M-O), 530.9 eV (M-OH), 532.0 eV (H₂O); N 1s at 400.0 eV (N-M-O).
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the Ni 2p XPS spectra (Fig. 4a), the two main peaks of the NiFe LDHs at 855.1 and 872.6 eV correspond to the Ni 2p₃/₂ and Ni 2p₁/₂ of Ni(III)... Note that the Ni(II) 2p₃/₂ peaks of the NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE and NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE are positively shifted by 0.10 and 0.33 eV... The main peak of the N 1s spectrum (Fig. S4b) is located at 400.0 eV, which is presumably attributed to the N-M-O bond.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE shows ν(Niᴵᴵ-O) at 460 and 516 cm⁻¹ at 0.4 V vs Hg/HgO, shifting to 461 and 543 cm⁻¹ at 0.45 V confirming irreversible Niᴵᴵᴵ-O formation; shows -COOH at 1634 cm⁻¹; NiFe LDHs shows weaker Niᴵᴵᴵ-O signals.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 5a shows the in-situ Raman spectrum of the NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE during the OER process. Two signals at 460 and 516 cm⁻¹ were observed at 0.4 V vs. Hg/HgO... At 0.45 V vs. Hg/HgO, the two signals were suddenly intensified and shifted to higher wavenumbers of 461 and 543 cm⁻¹... Note that the in-situ Raman spectra of the NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE show a -COOH stretching vibrational peak at location 1634 cm⁻¹ at any applied bias.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE shows smallest R_ct indicating fastest charge transfer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE shows the smallest R_ct (Table S2), indicative of its fast charger transfer process.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE has double-layer capacitance C_dl of 5.99 mF cm⁻², highest ECSA; NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE: 2.36 mF cm⁻²; NiFe LDHs: 2.33 mF cm⁻².
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figs. S10 and 6d, the NiFe LDHs-EDTA-AE possesses the largest double-layer capacitance (C_dl) of 5.99 mF cm⁻², which is more than two times those of the NiFe LDHs-TSC-AE (2.36 mF cm⁻²) and NiFe LDHs (2.33 mF cm⁻²).
